data.one_liner: Flutter plugin wrapping native Braintree SDKs for payments with cards, PayPal, and Google Pay.
data.what_it_does: Wraps native Braintree SDKs to enable payment processing inside Flutter applications. It supports both a ready-made Drop-in UI and granular custom Flutter UI flows for credit cards, PayPal, Google Pay, and Apple Pay.
use_when: You need to accept payments via Braintree in a Flutter app.
You want to use Braintree's native Drop-in UI for quick setup.
You want to implement a custom payment UI while using Braintree for tokenization.
avoid_when: You use Stripe instead of Braintree for your payment backend.
You are implementing standard in-app purchases via App Store or Google Play billing.
strengths: Supports both native Drop-in UI and custom tokenization flows.
Handles multiple payment methods including credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
Active maintenance with updates to native Braintree and Drop-In SDKs.
weaknesses: Device data collection is not yet supported for iOS.
Custom PayPal tokenization may have stability warnings in certain pre-releases.
Requires platform-specific configuration for URL schemes and Activities on Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum Android SDK to at least 21, adding intent filters and URL schemes for browser switches (PayPal/Venmo/3DS), updating iOS Podfile platform target to '12.0', and registering CFBundleURLTypes in Info.plist.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if your payment gateway is Stripe instead of Braintree.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you need digital goods billing via Apple App Store or Google Play Store rather than a payment gateway.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you prefer Adyen as your payment gateway provider.
